issue.title: test_ctrl_e_moves_to_line_end_while_completion_remains_open fails: ctrl+e leaves file completion inactive since the ctrl-f accept-key change
issue.description:
Found at origin/master 33e41c72e while verifying an unrelated glossary/Services-tab
wording change. The failure is identical with that change stashed (clean tree), and it
also reproduced at fdc3e3caf, so it does not come from the change under test.

`tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_file_completion.py::TestPromptFileCompletion::test_ctrl_e_moves_to_line_end_while_completion_remains_open`
fails at line 445:

    assert ta._file_completion_active is True
    AssertionError: assert False is True

The test presses `ctrl+t` (file completion opens, `_file_completion_active` is True),
then `ctrl+e`, and expects the cursor to move to line end while the completion menu
stays open. After `ctrl+e` completion is no longer active.

Root cause not established. Candidate: 307da2dac ("feat(ace): accept completion menus
with ctrl-f") rewrote the completion accept key handling in
`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_prompt_text_area_key_handling.py` and edited ~55 lines of this
same test file, so either the key handler now treats `ctrl+e` as an accept/close, or the
test was only partly migrated. A bisect against 307da2dac^ was attempted but did not
produce a usable result, so treat this as a lead, not a finding.

Not in any existing bead or active epic: sase-18f/sase-17x cover the lint gates and the
command-line feature, sase-184 covers the monitor-section prompt-panel tests, and the
other failing prompt-panel tests are CardPart-shaped (recorded on epic sase-17d).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails on every run: in the full widgets run, in isolated reruns of the file, and with the working tree stashed to a clean checkout, at both fdc3e3caf and 33e41c72e. It has never passed on a rerun of an unchanged tree.
